A '''city''' was located on a [[Rajine's planet|remote planet]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]] took the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Rajine]] and her victims to the city and raised a Force barrier over the planet to ensure that Rajine could not escape. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] defeated Rajine in the city.<ref name="No Way Out" />
